p1: With no rain, the brook dried up. The Lord sent Elijah to a town called Zarephath. A woman whose husband had died was picking up sticks.
Elijah asked her for water and a little bread. She said, “I have only a handful of flour and a little oil.”
Elijah said, “Do not be afraid. Make me a little cake first. The Lord says your flour and oil will not run out.”
p2: She could have kept her food. But she trusted the Lord and shared. There was always more flour and oil! They ate for many days.
When we share and trust the Lord, He takes care of us. Tonight, think of one thing you can share tomorrow.
old: Heavenly Father sent Elijah to a poor widow in another town. She had a little boy and almost no food left. She had just a tiny bit of flour and a tiny bit of oil. She thought it was their very last meal.
Elijah said, “Please make me a little bread first. Don’t be afraid.” The woman was kind. She shared her last food with the prophet, even though she was scared.
Then a miracle happened! Her jar of flour never got empty. Her oil never ran out. Every day there was enough food for the widow, her son, and Elijah.

Because the woman trusted God and shared, He blessed her with plenty. When we give even when it’s hard, Heavenly Father takes care of us. Sharing opens the door for blessings. God can make a little become a lot.
